shared_or_similar_visual_information: Hatching or color used to fill a selected region
mathematical_meanings: Left image: A selected geometric subregion whose plane area is distinguished from the unhatched parts. Right image: A colored annotation selecting the interior of the angle between two rays.
Rationales: The hatched triangle is a subarea inside a parallelogram. The red wedge is an angle marker between rays. The local boundaries show area-partition and angle-selection roles respectively.
